newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly unchanged.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly unchanged on Friday on expectations interest rates may have reached their bottom, traders said.
Small dips, however, were experienced in the one-week and one-year maturities.
"We've reached the bottom already. Rates will just stay at current levels until something else happens," a trader from a medium-sized bank said.
Dealers said Treasury bill rates, which fell sharply in the past two weeks, could rise at Monday's auction. This could prod banks to adjust their PHIBOR rates.
